bankHomographDispute.proposedRuling: Retain separate draft entries: financial institution and river-edge are synchronically distinct and have different immediate historical routes. Keep homographNumber 1/2 as provisional display metadata, not stable identity and not universal frequency order. OALD groups senses on one page and documents grouping exceptions to usual frequency order; Merriam-Webster uses numbered noun entries. Immediate origins differ, but deeper Germanic relationships should not be denied.
tradeoffs: Two entries clarify sense and Vietnamese mapping but imply one editorial numbering convention.
A grouped headword follows OALD display but masks distinct immediate histories; reference conventions differ.
bankHomographDispute.translationAndGraphImpact: No target, relation endpoint, or graph edge needs change; only display-number claims remain disputed.
